$comment: S0025 section 8, as data for tools/audit/rig.py evaluate. A row is a HYPOTHESIS until the owner promotes, adjusts or drops it (decision 14.1). On 2026-11-08 the owner promoted B-1, B-3, B-5a and B-7b on the phase A baseline of 2026-10-25 (run a-20261025-1); a promoted row carries 'status': 'promoted', 'promoted' (the date), 'baseline' (the measured value and its run) and 'command' (the one command that regenerates it - threshold decay). Promotion makes no row a release gate: the release sweep runs the phase A smoke as a report only (decision 14.1, 2026-11-08). 'source' names where the measurement comes from: sampler:<column> (or sampler:store_kib = cache_kib + files_kib), frames:<key>, latency:<key>, events:<key> (a scalar or a list written by a scene driver). 'kind': percentile_max (a percentile of a list), max (a scalar), level_band (5th..95th percentile of the series after warm-up inside [min, max]), slope_per_hour_max (growth slope with a 95% band, judged against the control run), deviation_max (largest distance from the median after warm-up), event_max (a scalar event time). 'modes' limits a row to a scene mode. B-1 is judged on `am start -W` TotalTime - device-clock timestamps with no adb round trip, so no floor bracket - and the spec's 'first catalog frame' wording needs either that reading or a new debug probe (owner decision 14.2); the UI-tree time to the first catalog row stays recorded beside it in every run folder.
